proposed_from.topic: Studentized sequential rerandomization for joint spillover and carryover inference. In even-G partial-interference groups observed over two-period blocks, randomize half the groups to each of two saturation levels using a predictable soft-rerandomization kernel applied to the exactly standardized complete-randomization imbalance, then assign fixed treatment counts within groups. For bounded nonanticipating lag-one potential outcomes and logged conditional inclusion probabilities, prove exact joint HT unbiasedness for direct and spillover effects, derive a root-GB martingale/combinatorial CLT, construct an observable conservative 2-by-2 studentizer and simultaneous Wald coverage, and prove Omega_RR=Omega_CR-(1-v_eta,kappa)P with the displayed standard-normal tilt constant and P the limiting projection covariance. Use the projection criterion to characterize every strictly improved contrast and retain the Yu--Ma--Liu/Bojinov--Shephard market experiment as a prospective design consumer, not a retrospective growing-G validation. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Complement symmetry gives exact conditional saturation propensities 1/2. The block score decomposes into a balanced-sign component and conditionally centered within-group noise with zero cross covariance and exactly unchanged within-group covariance. An observable estimator has conditional expectation equal to the block covariance plus a deterministic PSD completion. Exact enumeration over 1,536 legal assignments verified unbiasedness and this matrix identity; a genuinely adaptive alternating-block family has imbalance variances 53/16 and 29/16, positive-definite projection gain, and one common standardized tilt constant. Current neighboring anchors did not supply the joint theorem. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove Lemma G, a history-uniform finite-population Gaussian approximation for the balanced-sign two-vector score and standardized scalar imbalance that transfers soft-tilt-weighted quadratic moments even with singular score covariance. EARLY KILL TEST: Complete Lemma G first via random perfect matchings for bounded three-vector arrays; any legal triangular-array counterexample to its weighted second-moment approximation stops the launch. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/exp_multigroup_studentized_srsb_joint_inference.md
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest destination result, YuMaLiu2025, fixes a minimax two-stage schedule; the closest adaptive result, LiZhao2026Adaptive, has single-stage treatment arms; and the closest projection result, LiDingRubin2018, uses static hard rerandomization for a scalar ATE. The selected theorem changes the first load-bearing proof step in each: a complement-symmetric predictable saturation law produces a balanced-sign joint score whose soft-weighted quadratic moment must be transported uniformly over histories even at singular score covariance. That new lemma yields an explicit vector covariance identity while the exact two-stage split preserves within-group covariance, and logged pair probabilities plus PSD completion yield simultaneous observable inference. Current 2026 static saturation and broad-interference papers do not contain this conjunction.

seed_details.one_line: Integrate exact joint HT identification, a root-\(GB\) martingale/combinatorial limit, PSD studentization, and the soft projection covariance identity.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Theorems 1--2; Section 7 conclusion; Supplementary HT limit theory.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is transporting the balanced-sign score covariance through a predictable radial soft tilt rather than analyzing a fixed minimax timing design.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for predictable or sequential rerandomization jointly with spillover, carryover, Horvitz--Thompson, and saturation found no theorem matching the conjunction; HeTchetgen2026 and LiuShaikhZhong2026 are static neighbors.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from YuMaLiu2025 and LiZhao2026Adaptive by inserting logged propensities into their HT martingale.
seed_details.rebuttal: That insertion does not identify the tilted block covariance, handle singular weighted second moments, or control the impossible-pair matrix estimator.

seed_details.one_line: Prove a history-uniform Gaussian approximation for soft-weighted quadratic moments of bounded balanced-sign three-vectors, allowing singular score covariance.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Theorem 1 finite-population CLT; Section 6 discussion; Appendix rank-statistic construction.
seed_details.proof_boundary: Cram\'er--Wold weak convergence must be replaced by covariance-range moment transport for an unbounded quadratic score times a predictable radial weight.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining finite-population Gaussian approximation, weighted quadratic moments, balanced signs, and singular covariance found no direct result; ShiDing2026BerryEsseen and TianYangDing2025 are the closest method threads.
seed_details.red_team: A bounded smooth-test Berry--Esseen theorem already implies the desired expectation convergence.
seed_details.rebuttal: The test is unbounded in the score coordinates, the covariance can be singular, and uniformity over adaptive histories is not supplied by the cited bounds.

seed_details.one_line: Characterize the exact soft-rerandomization covariance reduction and every strictly improved direct-spillover contrast.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Proposition 2 and Theorem 1; Proposition 3; Section 7 conclusion and appendix orthogonal decomposition.
seed_details.proof_boundary: Hard static Gaussian truncation becomes predictable soft reweighting of a vector score plus fixed-count within-group noise.
seed_details.destination_search: Static cluster rerandomization and sequential balance papers were located, but no adaptive saturation paper states \(\Omega_{\mathrm{RR}}=\Omega_{\mathrm{CR}}-(1-v)P\) or its iff contrast criterion.
seed_details.red_team: This is merely LiDingRubin2018 with an exponential acceptance function.
seed_details.rebuttal: The adaptive history, fixed-half support, joint causal vector, singular transport, and exactly unchanged second-stage covariance are new proof obligations.

seed_details.one_line: Construct an observable PSD-conservative \(2\)-by-\(2\) covariance estimator under logged adaptive pair probabilities and structural zeros.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Theorem 1; Section 4.2 covariance construction and proof; joint-testing development.
seed_details.proof_boundary: Static closed-form pair probabilities must be replaced by conditional logged probabilities and a history-uniform concentration argument for \(O(G^2)\) pair terms.
seed_details.destination_search: Adaptive IPW covariance and broad two-stage interference variance papers do not provide the stated impossible-pair PSD completion under predictable soft selection.
seed_details.red_team: The estimator is a routine Aronow--Samii or Jiang--Imai--Malani conservative variance formula.
seed_details.rebuttal: The exact matrix completion is straightforward, but concentration under a dependent predictable fixed-half law requires the new pair-probability lemma; it is retained as a support theorem rather than the headline.

seed_details.one_line: Build a Gaussian-prepivoted randomization test exact for joint sharp saturation nulls and valid for joint weak nulls under the adaptive design.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Sections 3 and 5; main Gaussian-prepivoting theorem; Section 9 summary.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The Gaussian reference must incorporate the predictable soft kernel, a bivariate completed covariance, and singular limits.
seed_details.destination_search: LiuShaikhZhong2026 now supplies sharp- and weak-null testing for static randomized saturation designs, leaving only the adaptive carryover extension.
seed_details.red_team: CohenFogarty2022 plus LiuShaikhZhong2026 already covers the scientific object, with adaptivity only a technical overlay.
seed_details.rebuttal: The adaptive extension is not written, but the 2026 static saturation result collapses the broader novelty claim.

seed_details.one_line: Derive sharp finite-population lag-misspecification bias bounds and honest simultaneous regions for direct and spillover effects.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; misspecified carryover-order analysis; Section 7 conclusion.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first altered step optimizes omitted treatment-history cells jointly with the known adaptive assignment law rather than centering a CLT at the biased pseudo-target.
seed_details.destination_search: BojinovRambachanShephard2021 and BojinovSimchiLeviZhao2023 treat dynamic histories or switchback misspecification, but not joint saturation spillovers under predictable rerandomization.
seed_details.red_team: Bounded outcomes give only trivial worst-case bias bounds.
seed_details.rebuttal: The known exposure-path probabilities and repeated held assignments impose nontrivial coupling constraints, but sharpness requires a separate optimization paper.

seed_details.one_line: Choose \((\eta,\kappa)\) to minimize worst-contrast variance subject to an acceptance-cost constraint and certify optimality.
seed_details.anchor_location: Variance-reduction formulas following Proposition 3 and the design-efficiency discussion.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The shrinkage constant is explicit, but the projection covariance depends on outcome-aligned directions unavailable before the experiment.
seed_details.destination_search: YuMaLiu2025 optimizes timing and saturation probabilities, while no located paper optimizes a predictable soft tilt for the joint effect vector.
seed_details.red_team: The optimum is trivially the hardest feasible tilt because \(v_{\eta,\kappa}\) is monotone.
seed_details.rebuttal: A nontrivial result needs a computational or robustness constraint and an ex ante proxy for \(P\); those ingredients are not yet defensible.

seed_details.one_line: For fixed even \(G\) and growing \(B\), use exact finite-support covariance rather than a Gaussian tilt to obtain joint root-\(B\) inference.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; dynamic causal-effect definitions; finite-population limit theorems; Section 7 conclusion.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The block score has two-stage within-group interference and an exact history-dependent finite support rather than a single panel assignment path.
seed_details.destination_search: LiZhao2026Adaptive covers growing-time adaptive inference but not the exact small-\(G\) saturation covariance and impossible-pair completion.
seed_details.red_team: This is a direct finite-state martingale CLT once \(G\) is fixed.
seed_details.rebuttal: The exact covariance and matrix completion remain useful, but the theorem is too routine to displace the growing-\(G\) kernel.

seed_details.one_line: Develop adaptively adjusted AIPW inference for the joint two-stage lagged exposure vector.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Theorems 1--2; AIPW covariance section; Section 7 discussion.
seed_details.proof_boundary: Single-unit arms become saturation-conditioned fixed-count exposure categories with group dependence and carryover.
seed_details.destination_search: Liu2026CovariateAdaptive supplies static two-stage covariate adjustment, so novelty requires outcome-adaptive repeated blocks and a new efficiency target.
seed_details.red_team: This is a notational lifting of LiZhao2026Adaptive and Liu2026CovariateAdaptive.
seed_details.rebuttal: The lifting has dependent exposure categories, but no distinct efficiency frontier was found, so it is not retained as a standalone seed.

seed_details.one_line: Extend the soft projection theorem to a multivariate predictable balance vector under fixed-half saturation support.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; cluster-level joint limit; weighted-Euclidean and tiered rerandomization comparison; concluding design recommendations.
seed_details.proof_boundary: Scalar standardized imbalance becomes a possibly singular multivariate balance covariance whose radial tilt must be analyzed on its support.
seed_details.destination_search: Static cluster rerandomization covers multivariate hard thresholds; no soft outcome-adaptive saturation analogue was located.
seed_details.red_team: The vector result follows immediately by replacing the one-dimensional Gaussian integral with a radial chi-square integral.
seed_details.rebuttal: The Gaussian calculation is easy, but uniform singular-support transport under adaptive fixed-half sampling is materially harder; it is postponed until the scalar kill test closes.

proposed_from.literature_map: Chosen kernel: Yu--Ma--Liu (2025) supplies the spillover-and-carryover destination model; Li--Zhao (2026) supplies the finite-population adaptive martingale template; Jiang--Imai--Malani (2023) supplies static joint two-stage covariance architecture; Li--Ding--Rubin (2018) and Lu et al. (2023) supply projection geometry. Open probability step: Li--Ding (2017) gives vector finite-population CLTs, Shi--Ding (2026) gives linear and quadratic permutation Berry--Esseen bounds, and Tian--Yang--Ding (2025) gives heterogeneous-stratum Stein couplings, but none transports a soft-weighted unbounded score quadratic uniformly on singular covariance support. Collision checks: Jizhou Liu (2026) is static covariate-adaptive two-stage inference; He--Tchetgen Tchetgen (2026) is broad static two-stage interference inference; Liu--Shaikh--Zhong (2026) is static saturation randomization testing; Zhou et al. (2018) is sequential balance without spillovers; no closer result subsumes predictable outcome-adaptive saturation, lag-one carryover, joint HT inference, PSD matrix completion, and the standardized projection identity.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:joint-design-clt; thm:studentizer; thm:wald-coverage
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The asymptotic conclusions are conditional on joint G,B growth, predictable covariance stabilization, and a positive-definite limiting covariance.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Root-GB normality and conservative Wald coverage hold under the stated triangular-array regularity conditions, not for arbitrary fixed-market or degenerate-variance deployments.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:projection-covariance
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The gain matrix P depends on unobserved potential-outcome scores and is not an ex ante observable screening statistic in the present core.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The iff c'Pc>0 is a population design-comparison characterization, not a deployable contrast-selection rule without a separately developed proxy or estimation result.

banked_reason: The cited martingale CLT has the reciprocal Lindeberg cutoff epsilon*V_T^(-1/2); a Rademacher triangular array satisfies its premises but not its Gaussian conclusion.
